subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default picker display policy, or by folding it into broader model-picker grouping/runtime-label work?
rationale: OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config surface, and adjacent open picker work already explores grouping, runtime labels, and auth-route visibility, so the permanent UX contract needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
options.body: Prefer deciding a default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want per-user preference after that policy is clear.

options.title: Add the requested opt-in config
options.body: Accept the extra config surface and require one documented schema path that applies consistently to Control UI and TUI with focused regression tests.

options.title: Fold into picker metadata work
options.body: Route this to the provider grouping/runtime-label cluster so maintainers avoid parallel label schemes and competing picker settings.

recommendation.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
recommendation.body: Prefer deciding a default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want per-user preference after that policy is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans the Control UI/TUI/config surfaces where this product decision would land.
